units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8:4">Num. R. s. 8</cite> the nations said <he>תורתן של אלו פ׳ הוא</he> that people’s Law is a fraud (they do not observe it themselves); Midr. Sam. ch. XXVIII <cite ref="Q01106"><he>פלסתר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:8:2">Y. B. Mets. V, end, 10ᵈ</cite> <he>שעישין התורה פלסטרן ואת משה טפש</he> (corr. acc.) they (the usurers), declare the Law (forbidding usury) a fraud, and Moses a fool; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 6:17">Tosef. B. Mets. VI, 17</cite> <cite ref="Q01106"><he>פלסטר</he></cite>; (Bab. ib. 75ᵇ <he>משה חכם ותורתו אמת</he>, euphem.). Y’lamd. to Num. XVI, quot. in Ar. <he>פ׳ הוא תורתו וכ׳</he> the law of Moses is a fraud.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 321">Yalk. Jer. 321</cite> <he>מה שאנו רואים … פלסטרו הוא</he> (corr. acc.) as far as we can judge your Law, it is a fraud (its predictions are not inspired); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 321:5">ib.</cite> <he>אין דבר בתורה פלסטרון ולא וכ׳</he> not a word in the Law is a fabrication or a falsehood. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Lekh 10 <he>פלסטין הוא</he> (corr. acc.) the document is forged.
